title: 51 Castlepark, Caherconlish, Limerick, V94HE6T
description:
O'Connor Murphy Auctioneers are delighted to bring to the market 51 Castlepark, Caherconlish. Situated in the heart of Caherconlish village, this three-bedroom semi-detached home offers well-proportioned family accommodation with a private walled rear garden and off-street parking to the front. Just a two-minute walk from the local national school and a 15-minute drive from Limerick City, the property is ideal for families seeking the convenience of village living with easy access to the city.


ACCOMMODATION:

The property comprises an entrance hallway, guest WC, living room and kitchen/dining room. Upstairs, there are three bedrooms, one ensuite and a family bathroom.


GROUND FLOOR:

Entrance Hallway Tiled flooring, carpeted staircase with pine balustrade, pine doors and skirting throughout.
Guest WC Located under the stairs. Tiled floor and walls, WC and WHB.
Living Room Front facing room with timber flooring and a marble fireplace with cast iron insert and black hearth. Glazed double doors open to the kitchen/dining room.
Kitchen/Dining Room Tiled flooring throughout. Kitchen fitted with wall and floor units, glass-fronted display cabinet, tiled splashback and built-in oven with extractor hood over. Plumbed for washing machine and dishwasher. Dining area with sliding patio door to the rear garden.


FIRST FLOOR:

Landing Carpeted, with pine balustrade, window and attic access.
Bedroom 1 Double bedroom with carpet flooring and fitted wardrobes.
Ensuite Shower room, fully tiled. WC, WHB and shower.
Bedroom 2 Double bedroom with timber-effect flooring.
Bedroom 3 Bedroom with carpet flooring, currently used as a den. Also suited to use as a home office or nursery.
Family 
Bathroom Fully tiled. WC, WHB and bath with shower attachment and glass shower screen.


EXTERIOR:



Front garden Tarmacadam driveway providing off-street parking, lawn and timber fence boundaries. Gated side access to the rear.

Rear garden Private, walled-in rear garden with paved patio accessed via sliding door from the dining area. Lawn with stepping-stone pathways, mature trees, hedging and shrub borders. Timber garden shed.




LOCATION:



LOCATION:

51 Castlepark is situated in the heart of Caherconlish village, just a two-minute walk from Caherconlish National School. The village offers a full range of everyday amenities, including shops, pubs, a post office, St. Ailbe's Credit Union, a HSE health centre, the local church and the Millennium Centre, a busy community hub with a sports arena and function hall. Caherconlish GAA club is based in the village, while Ballyneety Golf Club and the historic Lough Gur are within easy reach. For secondary education, John the Baptist Community School in nearby Hospital is served by school transport from the area.

Caherconlish is an ideal commuter location, just off the N24 Limerick Waterford route with easy access to the M7 motorway. Limerick City is a 15-minute drive away, with the University of Limerick and Castletroy also within easy reach, and Bus Éireann route 328 provides a direct service to Limerick City.
